parameters.name: AddressType
parameters.description:
The type of the IP addresses. Valid values:

*   Internet: Users can connect to the SLB instance over the Internet.
*   Intranet: Users can connect to the SLB instance over the internal network.

parameters.name: SlbType
parameters.description:
The type of the SLB instance. Valid values:

*   clb: Classic Load Balancer (CLB)
*   alb: Application Load Balancer (ALB)

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas list-slb --vpc-id vpc-bp1f90rfybszjogyw0000 --address-type internet --slb-type clb --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun edas GET /pop/v5/slb_list --region cn-hangzhou --VpcId 'vpc-bp1f90rfybszjogyw0000' --AddressType internet --SlbType clb --header "Content-Type=application/json"
